name: Couch Co-op
summary: Several players on one machine, joining by pressing a button, sharing one camera.
description: Watches unclaimed gamepads for a join press, spawns and possesses a player for each, and gives every player their own devices so one mouse does not turn everybody's pawn. A camera rig frames all the living players at once, which is how Overcooked and Castle Crashers do it; split-screen is a separate piece of engine work.
nextSteps: Add a LocalPlayers component to the actor that carries the GameMode.
Add a CoopCameraRig to the camera tagged MainCamera3D so it frames everyone.
Give the scene at least as many Player Start actors as MaxPlayers, or players will share one.
